# Dwellinger — llms.txt
# Version 1.2 — October 2026
# Status: pre-launch / soft-live — no contractors onboarded

## About Dwellinger

Dwellinger (dwellinger.co.uk) is a UK contractor trust and verification platform and a property and construction intelligence toolkit.

Dwellinger is a platform, not a contractor. It does not manage or deliver construction projects.

Contact: info@dwellinger.co.uk

## What Dwellinger does

Dwellinger enables homeowners and property professionals to find and verify building contractors across Greater London (all 32 London boroughs and the City of London) and the Home Counties.

Audiences:
- Homeowners: primary; London projects of approximately £50k–£250k
- Contractors: platform plans, Builder Score™, leads
- Property investors: appraisal tools
- Professionals: architects, project managers, consultants

## What is live today

- Free calculators: extension, loft, bathroom, kitchen, garage, cost, HMO, ROI, development appraisal, materials guide
- Ask Dwellinger AI chat (powered by OpenAI gpt-4o-mini; not professional advice)
- Planning intelligence pages (sample data — live council feed in development)
- Estimating packages: Outline £95, Standard £150, Full £250, Premium £350 — manual service; request form, payment link sent by email within 1 working day

## What is planned (not yet live)

- Contractor directory with Builder Score™ ratings (no contractors onboarded yet)
- Contractor platform plans: Member £49, Professional £99, Premium £199, Franchise £499 (planned pricing)
- Magic-link login and contractor accounts (pending email provider setup)
- Project Passport and scope builder (built; not reachable until login is working)
- Live council planning data feed
- "Check a builder" tool with Companies House live lookup

## Builder Score™

Builder Score™ is a 0–1000 trust rating for UK building contractors. Status: draft methodology — not yet applied to any contractor.

Six components (weights, max points):
- Verified reviews: 35% (350 points)
- CDM compliance record: 20% (200 points)
- Payment behaviour: 15% (150 points)
- Insurance and accreditation: 15% (150 points)
- Dispute resolution record: 10% (100 points)
- Response rate and platform activity: 5% (50 points)

Score tiers: Platinum 900–1000 / Gold 700–899 / Silver 500–699 / Bronze 0–499.
Scores are shown only for contractors who opt in and consent. No contractor has been scored.

Methodology v1.0-draft — October 2026. Full method at /builder-score.
